summary.text: Bob Nicholas is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 7 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
An attorney and businessman, he faces Democrat Gavin Lobmeyer in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Bob Nicholas earned a B.A. in political science from the University of Wyoming in 1982 and a J.D. from the University of Wyoming in 1985.
Ballotpedia lists his career experience as a businessman and attorney.
Ballotpedia lists Nicholas's tenure in the Wyoming House as beginning in 2011 and shows him assuming office for District 7 on January 2, 2023.

He chaired the House Appropriations Committee in the 2017, 2019-2020 and 2021-2022 sessions, and for 2025-2026 he was assigned to the House Transportation, Highways and Military Affairs Committee and the Select Committee on Capital Financing and Investments.
He defeated Deb Shamley in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 65.6% to 34.4%.
